title: Incremental experimental model rollout playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Playbook for a staged, observable rollout of new or experimental model variants into the Model Catalog Experimental Channel. Emphasis on safe telemetry gating, benchmark baselines, partial catalog visibility, regional gating, and fast rollback. Designed to coordinate PM, Eng, Design, Legal, and GTM for low-friction iterations while preserving production SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Model visible in Experimental channel with correct metadata and version pin
Benchmarks published to internal dashboard (latency, p95, throughput, regression delta) and within acceptable guardrails
Docs and Quickstart for experimental model live in the docs site and linked from catalog entry
Telemetry hooks instrumented (token counts, error codes, cold-starts, latency buckets) and alerts configured
Rollback path validated via canary routing and automated fallback policy documented
checklist: PM: Create catalog entry with experimental flag and clear disclaimer
Eng: Add model to canary pool with route tag = experimental-canary and quota 5% traffic
Eng: Validate quantization and kernel profile integration for target GPUs; run nightly perf job
Design: Provide sample prompts and structured output examples; ensure UI shows experimental badge
Benchmarks: Run standard eval suite + domain-specific benchmarks; capture baseline and delta vs production model
Telemetry: Wire up metrics (p50/p95 latency, token cost, error rates, memory pressure) and create dashboard tile
SRE: Configure SLOs and automated rollback triggers (latency > +30% or error rate > 2%)
Privacy/Legal: Confirm no additional PII handling obligations and KMS config as needed
Docs: Publish Quickstart, API examples, and release note draft (internal review)
GTM: Draft customer-facing announcement template and internal sales brief
Localization: Queue minimal translated strings for region-specific launches (EU, APAC)

Design (Helena): Add tooltip copy explaining experimental badge and suggested fallback text.

rollback_conditions: Sustained p95 latency increase > 30% over baseline for 10 minutes
Error rate > 2% for 5 minute sliding window
Memory pressure > 85% on any node for 2 consecutive minutes
Customer-facing escalation received from sales or support for critical regression
comms: Internal: Slack #pm-launch + #runtime with summary, links to dashboard and checklist
Sales: One-pager with model capabilities, example prompts, known limitations
External (if promoted): Release notes + sample outputs and usage guidance
Support: Playbook for troubleshooting common regressions and escalation path
estimated_cost_impact: expected unit cost change: +8% for experimental config due to disabled caching; offset recommendations: enable prefix caching after 2-week stability window
